maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from renting and selling composite DURA-BASE matting for new project site access, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private utilities, pipeline and energy companies renting matting for projects; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly from matting rentals and sales; a few Northeast acquisitions (WGS, UAS, Lentzcaping) are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Temporary matting rentals for projects can be sourced from other mat suppliers; switching is relatively easy.
